title: Categorize contracts + handlers: queue with bundles, run start/status, accept batch, skip, threshold settings
description: shared/src/contracts/categorize/: categorize_queue_list (uncategorized transactions with suggestions, grouped into bundles = same payee + same top suggestion, paged; threshold applied at read time), categorize_run_start, categorize_run_status, categorize_accept (batch of {transaction_id, category_id}; goes through the existing transaction update path), categorize_skip, categorize_settings_get/set (per-budget threshold). Nothing is ever applied without an explicit accept. Queue must work with no AI key (rows with no suggestions). Plan, decisions and owner answers: handoff.md at the repo root. Mock: tk show budget-seoa (evidence ev-c96ced overview, PNGs). Follow AGENTS.md (contracts, migrations additive only + MIGRATION_SIGNATURES, i18n, ports, test DB rules).
notes:
Owner decision 2026-11-24 (Inbox thread): in a shared budget a run uses the budget OWNER's AI key (or shared AI if the owner has it), whoever starts the run. Any member may start a run. The queue output must carry the merchant fields for the merchant panel (legal name, CNPJ, business category, operation type, PIX counterparty).
From review-fvtx-3: readCategorySuggestions currently masks and truncates (200/80 chars) the user's OWN memo, payee and bank text, because it reuses the model-facing shape. For the queue endpoint the user must see their own data unmasked and untruncated; masking and caps apply only to what is sent to the model. Also: a transaction with any accepted or dismissed suggestion is never re-classified; the queue must distinguish 'not classified yet' from 'classified, no suggestion' (readCategorizeAttempts). No caller passes force today: decide whether Run classification offers an explicit re-classify.
Checkpoint 2 at HEAD 3bd2c7e.

Operations (all /categorize, behind budgetAccess): GET /queue (API+CLI+MCP), POST /run (API+CLI, no MCP), GET /run (API+CLI+MCP), POST /accept (API+CLI+MCP, same exposure as budget_transactions_update), POST /undo (API+CLI, no MCP), POST /skip (API+CLI+MCP), GET /settings and PUT /settings (API+CLI+MCP).
Queue: own text unmasked/untruncated, merchant panel, five states, suggestions at threshold, whole-queue bundles/counts; threshold from 0113 read at read time; default 0.8.
Run: no force flag (a capped forced run would re-bill the newest 100 each click); any member starts, tenant is the owner, no-key start is 409 categorize_ai_unavailable; status reads done/total from 0114 progress (written by prepare/chunk activities), last run and the AI reason.
Accept: batch through updateTransactionInClient inside one transaction, assignable category, still needs a category, refuses decided rows, marks the matching suggestion accepted (manual row when not among them) and dismisses the rest; repeat of the same pair is idempotent; concurrent different categories: one wins, the other 409 (test).
Undo: one round trip; clears category and restores non-manual suggestions to pending (deletes the manual row); changed-category items are skipped and listed in ; batch atomic.
Skip: dismisses all pending suggestions (budget-wide freeze, leaves queue), idempotent, 409 categorize_nothing_to_skip when there are none.
New codes: categorize_ai_unavailable (409), categorize_already_categorized (409), categorize_not_needing_category (409), categorize_nothing_to_skip (409), category_not_assignable (400). Reused category_not_in_budget and AI key 503 codes.
Checks: task typecheck clean; task lint clean; shared 217 pass/0 fail/0 skip; full api 1507 pass/0 fail/0 skip (101 files, BUDGET_REQUIRE_TEST_DB=1 on :55432). Main had not moved (4a62461), no merge needed.
Correction to the previous note: undo's skipped items are listed in the response field 'skipped' (array of transaction ids).
Independent review of 3bd2c7e (attached review-edxg.md): 1 blocker (undo acts as a general uncategorize endpoint), follow-ups F0-F10; sent back. Not approved.
B1 + accept idempotency checkpoint at 77a97b6 (in progress; F items not started).

Design: new table public.categorize_decisions (0115) stores transaction_id, budget_id, category_id accepted, accepting user_id, created_at. Accept requires an uncategorized row with no decided suggestion, so previous category is null and every previous suggestion status is pending by construction; it writes the row in the same transaction as the category and suggestion updates. Undo takes only transaction ids, reads the record for update, and reverses only a live, non-upcoming row whose current category still equals the recorded one; it clears via updateTransactionInClient, restores non-manual suggestions to pending, deletes the manual row and the decision. Everything else is skipped with reason no_decision | category_changed | upcoming | not_found. Repeat accept is a no-op only when that decision record matches; any other categorized row is 409 categorize_already_categorized.
Tests: repeat accept keeps the model suggestion and undo restores it to pending; P1 hand-set category; P2 uncategorized inflow; P3 upcoming occurrence (no record and with a record); P4 skipped row; P7 hand-categorized accept refused; undo changed-category and mixed batch.
